historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR is deeply negative (-2.60% over 5yr, -6.17% over 3yr) due to $25B+ in share buybacks reducing book value, not fundamental business deterioration. Equity CAGR diverges more than 30% from Revenue CAGR (13.07%) and EPS CAGR (9.05%). Using FCF 3yr CAGR (10.12%) as primary growth rate, consistent with FY2026 guidance of 9-10% revenue growth and management's ARR growth target of >10%.

base.notes: Anchored to FY2026 guidance of 9-10% revenue growth. FCF grows directly from base year FCF at stated rates. Growth decelerates from 10% toward terminal as AI monetization normalizes. WACC reflects Adobe's large-cap software profile: beta ~1.2, risk-free rate ~4.3%, ERP ~5.5%. Terminal growth of 3% consistent with long-run nominal GDP growth.

bull.notes: Bull case assumes Firefly AI monetization accelerates significantly, Acrobat Studio captures meaningful share of the business productivity market, and Semrush acquisition adds incremental growth. Higher FCF margin reflects operating leverage as AI revenue scales. Lower WACC reflects reduced execution risk as AI leadership becomes entrenched.

bear.notes: Bear case assumes AI commoditizes design tools faster than Adobe can monetize, Canva and Microsoft capture meaningful SMB share, and Digital Experience growth stalls. Growth decelerates sharply toward near-terminal levels. Higher WACC reflects elevated competitive and execution risk. Terminal growth of 2% reflects modest deceleration below nominal GDP.

sensitivity.notes: Each cell shows intrinsic value per share using Base Case FCF projections at the given WACC (rows) and terminal growth rate (columns) combination. Net cash of $385M added to all scenarios.
